accepted-design.text: Identity is the token plus the release. There is no saved identity, join command, caller-supplied reference hint or forever lock. Anyone can rebuild and publish checked reference scripts to outputs they control, and spend them back. Search tries the provider before the actor wallet, reading only missing needed roles and hashing exact candidate scripts locally. Empty provider answers establish only provider absence. The accepted rulings of 2026-10-06 and 2026-10-07 remain authoritative: permissionless republishing, saved-selector retirement, archive-bound page facts, shared state carrier retirement, a closed funding interface and independently checked report action identity.

ownership-and-serial-order.text: Feature epic #371 owns #437; Demo #301 and issue #381 consumes its delivered path. The approved working team is retained Sol delivery owner, native Muse muse-spark-1.3-contributor and native GLM glm-5.3, serially, with no auditor or extra seat. One implementation writer owns the worktree at a time. Sol owns planning, rebase/integration, command receipts and PR bodies. E371 owns merge and product acceptance.

The rebase, GLM baseline repairs and Muse public-Bob/refusal repairs have source handbacks. Their source evidence is retained without claiming product acceptance. The delivery owner now freezes the first slice and starts draft hosted CI alongside required local checks, prioritizing the missing deliberate-open control on the reordered journey. Later bounded Muse/GLM phases deliver the remaining slices. The parent changes writers only after a durable handoff and a clean source boundary. The withdrawn parallel-runner experiment adds no further repair campaign.
